title: Artificial Creativity?
core_idea: Investigate whether an AI whose outputs are correlated with human inputs in an opaque way can be considered creative by analyzing cases (e.g., Edmond de Belamy) and testing the notion of creative AI against traditional philosophical definitions of creativity, the concept of meta-sensemaking, and the epistemology of creativity, while reflecting on creativity's role in making sense of human existence.
tldr: The paper questions the notion of 'creative AI' and outlines a threefold examination—philosophical definitions of creativity, meta-sensemaking, and the epistemology of creativity—using case studies to clarify what is at stake and to keep focus on creativity's role in meaning-making.
